text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering-heartbeat fragmentation detected (token emission != ledger delta). Alert: https://redwood/alerts/INC-63021 — severity: P2.

alex: ack, I'm looking. Which pipeline?

maria: seeing a burst in emitter retries from emitter-prod-2 around 12:36 UTC, kafka offsets spiking.

devon: running quick query to check ledger vs emitter sums.

alex: paste the sql?

devon: ```sql
SELECT window_start, sum(emitted_tokens) as emitted, sum(ledger_count) as ledger
FROM metering.batches
WHERE window_start >= '2025-03-12T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 6;
```

maria: results: 2025-03-12T12:30:00Z window shows emitted=1245678, ledger=1012345 -> ~232k token delta. next window matches earlier baseline.

alex: that delta pattern looks like duplicate replays from emitter side. Any deploys or rollout?

maria: no deploys in the last 3 hours. Can confirm emitter-prod-2 logs show repeated Produce errors then retries. snippet: `ProducerTimeoutException -> retry(2)` repeated.

devon: ok I'm going to pause emitter-prod-2 consumer to stop further duplication. command: `kubectl scale deployment emitter-prod-2 --replicas=0 -n metering`

maria: executing pause now.

maria: paused emitter-prod-2 at 12:38:07 UTC. monitoring backlog.

oncall-bot: Status update: emitter-prod-2 paused (manual) by maria. Alert suppressed for emitter-prod-2.

alex: start a ledger resync job on staging-first then prod dry-run. runbook ref: https://redwood.runbooks/metering/reconciliation#emit-duplicates

devon: kicking off reconcile job: `scripts/reconcile_tokens --window 2025-03-12T12:30:00Z --mode=estimate` -> estimation shows ~230k duplicate tokens attributable to emitter-prod-2 retries.

sam: billing FYI — we have ~14 customer accounts that hit overage flags during that window. I need the customer list and token counts to prepare credits.

maria: brief list (obfuscated): cust_084, cust_112, cust_401, cust_773 — totals: [18k, 12k, 9k, 7k] tokens flagged. full CSV at s3://redwood-incidents/6302109876/affected_customers.csv

sam: thanks. i'll pause auto-charges for those accounts and prepare one-off credits. please confirm timeframe window and final delta after reconcile.

devon: reconcile estimate currently 230233 extra tokens total across windows 12:30-12:40. will run final correction once we unpause and run idempotent ledger stitch.

alex: decision: 1) keep emitter-prod-2 paused, 2) suppress automated overage alerts for affected accounts until reconcile completes, 3) billing to issue provisional credits, 4) plan a safe emitter-deploy with retry backoff fix.

ops-rotation: copying to @billing-team and @platform-release. We'll monitor for 30m, update at +30. Any objections?

sam: no objections, proceeding with credits. Will update when done.

maria: creating incident ticket in JIRA: MTR-63021, attaching logs and CSV.

devon: once reconcile job is finished I'll run `reconcile_tokens --apply --window 2025-03-12T12:30:00Z` and post results.

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow the post-incident checklist: collect metrics, attach runbook steps, and schedule RCA.

alex: good work team. keep updates short here. next update at 12:58 UTC or earlier if anything changes. :thumbsup:

ops-rotation: acknowledged — will update in 30.
